notes: From recruiter-handbook.netlify.app and the owner's messages, 2026-10-16. Review, then tick the approval box and publish.

facts.title: Who we are
facts.content: TBT express is the carrier, and my manager on the recruiting team will work with you.

facts.title: Equipment
facts.content: We run dry van only, so no endorsements are needed.

facts.title: Truck assignment
facts.content: I can't promise a specific truck, year, or a new unit. My manager can go over what's available.

facts.title: Experience
facts.content: We need at least 2 years of solo experience, or at least 1 year as a team driver.

facts.title: Driving record
facts.content: Your MVR and PSP can each show no more than 2 moving violations.

facts.title: Clearinghouse
facts.content: Your Clearinghouse needs to be clear, and we can't move forward with a SAP history.

facts.title: Orientation
facts.content: You're hired after you pass a pre-trip inspection and a road test at orientation.

facts.title: Start date
facts.content: We're looking to start as soon as possible, and there's some flexibility on the date.

facts.title: Before the truck is ready
facts.content: Plan for about two unpaid days before your truck is available.

facts.title: Pay rate (solo)
facts.content: Solo pay is 75 to 85 cents per mile, depending on your driving record and whether you agree to a driver-facing camera. My manager will confirm your exact rate.

facts.title: Pay rate (team)
facts.content: Team pay is up to $1.10 per mile, depending on your records and experience. My manager will confirm your exact rate.

facts.title: When you get paid
facts.content: Your first week is paid in your second week.

facts.title: Tax status
facts.content: You'd be a 1099 contractor, so no taxes are withheld. For tax questions, please talk to a tax professional.

facts.title: Escrow
facts.content: Escrow is returned after 45 days, less any claims, damage, or violations.

facts.title: Home time
facts.content: Home time depends on how long you stay out: 3 weeks out gets 3 days home, 4 weeks out gets 4 days home, and 5 weeks out gets 6 days home.

facts.title: Where we run
facts.content: We don't run to the West Coast or into New York City. We run the rest of the states.

facts.title: Sign-on bonus (solo)
facts.content: Solo drivers get a $3,000 sign-on bonus, paid out as $1,000 a month.

facts.title: Sign-on bonus (team)
facts.content: Teams get a $20,000 sign-on bonus, $10,000 for each driver. It's paid out as $4,000 every 3 months, and $8,000 at month 12.

facts.title: Referral bonus
facts.content: You get a $500 referral bonus when a driver you refer has worked with us for 2 weeks.
